page.title: Reservations cockpit
page.description: Track bookings, optimise capacity, and wow every guest from one unified view.
page.bookingLinkDescription: Share this link so clients can book a table online. They'll see availability and get a confirmation by email or WhatsApp when contact details are provided.

waitlistQueue.emptyDescription: Guests waiting for a table will appear here.
